payload.thesis: Harden Nolane Agent as an evidence-backed premium desktop agent without claiming untested provider or platform behavior.
activeHypotheses: The v3 home can be compact and task-first without losing project, model, command, or provider controls.
Hosted GitHub runners can certify runner-bound gates but cannot truthfully certify credentialed third-party services or user-owned hardware.
Cross-platform release requires a new signed update contract; the current Windows NSIS-only contract must not be generalized by naming alone.
strongestEvidence: Commit ed62c1d compacted the home composition; 14 focused home tests passed and GitHub visual run 31402307720 passed.
Commit 4fd41cf added a real nocturne and emerald visual receipt; GitHub visual run 31402991172 passed.
Commit 29f7aab adds a real Settings scroll-preservation journey; GitHub visual run 31403380446 passed.
GitHub external gate run 31402307732 passed on Windows, macOS, and Linux; it validates only runner-observable contracts.
Source quality gates passed: tokens, capability audit, UI release verification, evidence freshness, and master-ledger verification.
rejectedAlternatives: Do not package Electron or install Chromium locally; all browser visual work uses GitHub-hosted runners.
Do not publish an unsigned or unnotarized macOS build, or claim macOS/Linux self-update from the Windows NSIS updater.
Do not relabel remaining external credential and user-hardware claims as verified merely because a generic runner exists.
unknowns: 88 ledger records remain external_gate; credentialed providers, managed cloud services, user-machine accessibility/performance, and independent review still need their own receipts.
The current cross-platform release workflow remains Windows-only until the staged update-v3 implementation and signing environment are provisioned.
cleanup: No local Electron or browser package dependency was installed.
